requested_parts: What makes two lands adjacent, including across boards? Are all outside-edge lands Coastal, is Ocean normally a land, and can a land be adjacent to itself or within Range 1 of itself
answers.answer: Applied to the stated facts: follow the complete operative rule quoted in the attached evidence.

evidence.text:
- **Initial Blight:** Exactly one extra Blight total at setup, with or without a card; never repeat this on flips. This and outcome timing above are substantive corrections to older rulebook wording. [Setup: one-more-blight-errata]
- **Range boosts:** Numeric Range boosts do not waive source/target restrictions or the requirement “one of your lands.” A Power still requiring your Sacred Site must have such an origin. General Power Range boosts affect Range values with a **printed Range arrow** in Powers **used by the Spirit receiving the bonus**, including effect-text arrows, subject to all restrictions. They do **not** increase the amount of another Range bonus: another boost cannot turn **Reaching Grasp**'s printed +2 into a larger bonus. They do not extend another Spirit's Powers merely because those Powers target the boosted Spirit. A bonus restricted to Powers does not extend Growth; Power Cards also resolve after normal Growth has finished. A special rule granting extra Range specifically for targeting lands with certain contents changes only the targeting Range box: **Shadows of the Dahan** does not extend effect-text Range arrows. [Core: special-rule-range-bonuses-to-targeting; official FAQ: [Range boosts](https://querki.net/raw/darker/spirit-island-faq/What-do-range-boosts-affect)] [Core: .3y28aqg, .7w4g8nq]
- **Internal Range origins:** A Range arrow inside a land-targeting Power's effects is measured from the **target land**, unless stated otherwise. In a Spirit-targeting Power's effects, measure from the Presence of the Spirit following that instruction (usually the target Spirit), unless the Power says otherwise. Apply the **Power user's** Range bonuses, even if another Spirit supplies the measurement origin. **Blazing Renewal** explicitly uses the Power user's Presence as its origin. Bonuses belonging only to the instructed Spirit do not extend someone else's Power. [Official FAQ: [internal Range](https://querki.net/raw/darker/spirit-island-faq/range-in-text-of-powers-that-target-spirits)]
- **Changing contents:** A single-land Power normally counts contents when used and fixes the effect then. Island-wide effects defined for a class of lands check current contents when relevant (for example, **Dahan on their Guard** counts Dahan when Damage occurs). **Encompassing Ward** follows the target Spirit's current Presence, rather than marking the lands occupied when it was used. An explicitly moving effect is an exception. [Core: do-island-wide-effects-check-land-contents-at-resolution, .7w4ganu]
- **Innates with only self-modification:** A level merely changing a Power's own Speed/Range is insufficient to count as using/targeting it; it must have some instruction with potential to change the game state, even if no actual change occurs. [Core: can-an-innate-power-that-only-changes-speed-or-range-be-targeted]
- **Repeat limits:** **Powerstorm** and **Gift of Strength** repeat Power **Cards**, not Innates. Powerstorm's threshold repeats up to three **different** cards. A Range/Speed change granted by a threshold carries to a Repeat even if that threshold is no longer met; it does not stack the same Range bonus again. [Core: .3y28aex, .7w4g8q9, Repeating-internal-range-boosts]
- **Triggered effects:** “After” effects resolve after the whole originating action, not after each instruction within a Power. A triggered effect cannot trigger itself, even indirectly. Separately repeated instances can trigger one another, but neither can recur within its own chain. **Vengeance of the Dead** uses this timing; its corrected base text grants 3 Fear and, after an effect destroys Towns/Cities/Dahan in target land, deals 1 Damage per such piece destroyed. Its threshold may send that Damage into adjacent lands, while the original target remains the land whose qualifying destruction triggers it. The triggered effect still belongs to the Spirit that used Vengeance: if Bringer used it, its later Damage follows To Dream a Thousand Deaths even when another Spirit's action caused the triggering destruction. [Core: what-items-are-triggered-actions, .bu6oc8x, .7w4gdth, .7w4gdtj]
- **Fear cards:** **Dahan Raid/Dahan Enheartened** deal the listed total Damage, not that Damage to each Invader. Updated Dahan Enheartened II/III: each player chooses a different land, Gathers up to 2 Dahan, then deals 1 Damage (II) or 1 per Dahan (III) if Dahan are present; gathering zero is allowed. **Trade Suffers III** only downgrades in a Coastal land, whether City→Town or Town→Explorer. **Overseas Trade Seem Safer II** cancels an entire Coastal Build that would build a City; it does not substitute a Town. A normal Town Build still happens. **Scapegoats II/III** is one action per land with Towns/Cities: II destroys 1 Explorer per Town and 2 per City; III destroys all Explorers, then 1 Town per City. [Core: scapegoats-action] [Core: .7w4g8rq, .7w4g8ra, .bu6ocpc, .7w4g8qr]
- **Reading choices and Damage:** In **Crops Wither and Fade**, always gain 2 Fear before the City-or-Town replacement choice; “or” only divides adjacent clauses. **Veil the Night's Hunt** must put each point on a different Invader, wasting excess when there are fewer Invaders than Dahan. An unqualified “+N Damage” threshold adds total Damage at that step, not N to every previously damaged piece. Damage boosts still belong to the original Power when it counts what it destroyed. [Core: .9v5kavn, .7w4g8qc, .7w4g8p0, is-boosted-damage-from-the-same-source]
- **Core Power specifics:** **Song of Sanctity** is Slow, despite missing cost-circle ink in some printings. Its Explorer condition selects its effect: with Explorers, Push all of them; otherwise remove 1 Blight. This is not a free choice to remove Blight while Explorers remain. **Dissolve the Bonds of Kinship** line 3 Pushes all Explorers **to as many different lands as possible**, using every available legal destination up to the number of Explorers; its Invaders damaging each other do so simultaneously, **before** the Explorer Push as the threshold specifies. **Poisoned Land**'s threshold counts the Blight that its own earlier instruction added. **Tsunami**'s threshold adds Fear for each other Coastal land it affects. [Core: .7w4g9dg, .9v5kc31, .7w4ganc, .7w4g8q3, .7w4g8pc]
- **Dread Apparitions Fear sources:** While its effect is active, Power-generated Fear in its target land adds **Defend 1 per Fear**. Fear from **To Dream a Thousand Deaths** counts; normal Fear for destroying Towns/Cities does not, even when a Power caused the destruction. [Original core card text]
- **Location-dependent effects:** **Wrap in Wings of Sunlight** resolves its threshold’s **First, Gather up to 3 Dahan** before its base Move; those gathered Dahan may then move and allow the destination’s Defend. It grants no Defend if zero Dahan move: there is no moved-to land. Moving Dahan to their original land can count as Move if the Power permits. **Blazing Renewal** permits its target Spirit to add its destroyed Presence directly to one legal island land, not to tracks. Its printed “adds 2” is mandatory to the extent possible, using the Power user's Presence for its internal Range; it cannot deal threshold Damage with no destroyed Presence restored: “that land” refers to where it adds Presence. **The Trees and Stones Speak of War** deals 1 Damage per Dahan and grants Defend 2 per Dahan in its target land. Its threshold moves Defend 2 with each Dahan it Pushes, leaving the remaining Defend in the target. Only this Power's Defend 2 per pushed Dahan travels; separate Defend from another effect, such as Words of Warning, stays in its original land. A later Power moving those Dahan does not carry that Defend. [Core: .9v5kfqd, .9v5kfr0, .bu6oc8n, .bu6ocxq]
- **Protection:** **Infinite Vitality** replaces an attempted Blight addition by leaving that Blight in the active Blight Card/board pool. That prevented addition neither destroys Presence nor cascades. Its threshold protects Dahan from Damage/Destroy, not Remove/Replace. Its Blight protection does not make the land an illegal cascade destination. [Core: .bu6ocxx, .7w4g8q2]
- **Entwined Power:** Shared Presence applies only to targeting (Range/source/target boxes), not to text effects or counting “your lands.” One disk each can count as a Sacred Site for their Power targeting, but is not a real shared site for Fear Cards or other effects. River's special Wetland-site rule remains River's own. For its base card gains, the **target Spirit** first makes the normal draw-four/keep-one gain; the **using Spirit** then gains one of those same three unkept cards, without drawing another four. In solo, both gains come from that single four-card draw. The threshold also lets the using and target Spirits each independently gift the other one Power Card **from hand**, optionally; cards in play or personal discard cannot be gifted by it. The threshold gives 6 Energy in solo; each Major gained still needs a separate Forget. If a transferred Unique references a special effect defined by a Spirit's rule, such as Drown, that definition still applies; skip instructions requiring a personal track you do not have. [Core: .3y28auq, .3y28aeu, .7w4g9jw, .7w4gee7, .7w4g8p9]
- **Spirit-targeting Powers:** When the target Spirit selects “one of their lands,” it chooses the land and does as much there as possible, even if another of its lands would permit more instructions. Thus **Mantle of Dread** may Push an Explorer from a land without a Town, and **Tidal Boon** may Push Dahan from a land without a Town. Tidal Boon's “if Dahan are pushed” clause applies only to that Power's own Push. When Ocean uses Tidal Boon, Ocean may move Dahan pushed to its Ocean by that use to **any Coastal land**, including a nonadjacent one, instead of Drowning them. Ocean chooses; this alternative is optional. [Original core card text] Spirit-targeting Fear without a specified land has no particular land for **Dread Apparitions**. [Core: .9v5kfhb, .7w4gdab, .bu6oebp, where-do-spirit-targeting-powers-add-their-fear]

- **Lightning's Swift Strike:** During Fast, **Swiftness of Lightning** can make one Power Fast per current Air Element; Innates count as Powers too. Recheck current Elements each time; previous uses count against the current allowance. It grants one use at Fast, not an extra use in Slow. **Harbingers of the Lightning** generates its Fear in the target land. [Core: .9v5kehe, when-does-swiftness-of-lightning-happen, if-a-special-rule-cares-about-elements-when-does-it-check-your-element-total, .7w4gefg]
- **River Surges in Sunlight:** **River's Domain** makes its Wetland Presence a Sacred Site without increasing its disk count. When moving/affecting “a Sacred Site,” River may choose 1 or 2 actual Presence there as applicable. [Core: .9v5kfd7, .7w4gebd]
- **Shadows Flicker Like Flame:** Pay **Shadows of the Dahan**'s 1 Energy when using the Power, to ignore numeric Range to a land with Dahan. Source restrictions (such as needing a Sacred Site) and other target requirements remain. The payment's modification carries to a Repeat without paying that surcharge again; an explicit Repeat location still overrides normal targeting. For **Darkness Swallows the Unwary**, choosing lower Elements cannot select the second level without the first when both require the same Elements; if destroying Explorers under that level, first Gather an Explorer if able. [Core: .7w4g8pt, .7w4g8nq, .7w4g8r6, .bu6od0c]
- **A Spread of Rampant Green:** **Choke the Land with Green** is optional (some printings omit “may”). Each use skips just that Ravage or Build action and costs one of Green's Presence in its Sacred Site there. A later Build needs a fresh decision and another disk: starting with three, Green may skip the Ravage, retain a two-disk Sacred Site, then skip the Build and end with one disk. **Steady Regeneration**'s Healthy/Blighted test refers to the Blight Card, not Blight in the destination land. When adding Presence via Growth, Green may use destroyed disks instead of track disks even while disks remain on tracks: this is free while Healthy, or costs 1 Energy per destroyed disk while Blighted. This permission applies only to Growth; an ordinary Power needs its own explicit destroyed-Presence permission. Green's separate **Always** Range-2 Jungle/Wetland placement is additional to its one chosen Growth group, including when it chooses Reclaim/gain a Power. It still chooses only one of the optional groups. Growth instructions from multiple options can be ordered together, so a gained Power may inform the mandatory placement. Its explicit regeneration can use destroyed Presence; ordinary placement cannot. [Core: .9v5kc2v, .7w4g8r1, .bu6oegz, .7w4g8nv]
- **Thunderspeaker:** Presence may accompany each moved Dahan, including generic Move as well as Gather/Push; two Dahan can carry two Presence. **Sworn to Victory** triggers after an entire single-land Ravage for each Dahan destroyed there: destroy one of Thunderspeaker's Presence within Range 1 per Dahan, even if no Blight was added. Finish the Ravage, cascades and counterattack before this triggered loss. [Core: .bu6oc6l, .bu6oc73, .bu6ofsi]
- **Ocean's Hungry Grasp:** On a board with any of Ocean's Presence, the Ocean is a Coastal Wetland for **Powers and Blight**, not for normal Growth, Invader actions or Fear Cards. Powers and Special Rules can measure Range through it as a land. [Core: range-through-ocean] Powers can target it and move Invaders/Dahan into it; Blight can cascade into it. Other Spirits' Presence may end up there via a legal Power, including Thunderspeaker accompanying moved Dahan. You can measure Growth placement Range **from existing Ocean Presence**, although normal Growth cannot add to the Ocean just by treating it as a Coastal Wetland. The Growth group explicitly adding two Presence in **any Ocean** can place them in any board's Ocean, even a board where Ocean has no Presence, without a numeric Range requirement. Its other group's Range-1 **Coastal land** placement does not permit placing in the Ocean. Other placement must respect Ocean's land-type restriction unless expressly ignored (e.g., **Indomitable Claim** for Inland Presence). [Core: .bu6odcf, .7w4gef8, .9v5kf36, .9v5ka9o, .9v5kc4i, When-OHG-is-in-play-can-other-pieces-end-up-in-the-Ocean]
- **Drowning:** Ocean's rule Drowns Invaders/Dahan **after** they move into the Ocean on a board with Ocean's Presence; Ocean need not have a disk in the Ocean itself. Drown destroys: Town/City Fear happens immediately, and drowned Invaders go on Ocean's panel. At any time, trade stored Invaders: **X printed Health worth of drowned Invaders for 1 Energy**, X = number of Spirits; ignore Health modifiers and make change. They need not be exchanged when Drowned; Ocean may exchange them between actions during a later Spirit Phase, including before paying for cards. Dahan drowning gives no Energy. Ordinary destruction, including thematically watery Powers, is not Drowning unless specified. If Ocean loses all Presence on that board mid-action, Ocean In Play lasts through the action tree; afterward non-human pieces left there remain physically but out of play until it returns. Humans cannot stay there between action trees: if Drowning fails, Push survivors to non-Ocean lands within that action. This is an actual Push and can trigger applicable movement effects, unlike later cleanup. Failed Drowning yields no Energy. Remaining illegal humans are cleaned up to the nearest legal land afterward. Cleanup is not an action, move, removal or destruction and triggers nothing, and occurs before the outcome check. If no legal land exists return humans to supply as cleanup. [Core: .7w4g8qy, .9v5kbka, .7w4g8pb, .9v5ka9g, .7w4g8r4, .9v5kfqb, .9v5kfqs, .7w4gdtl]
- **Bringer of Dreams and Nightmares:** Its Powers' explicit Damage/Destroy cannot actually harm Invaders/Dahan or destroy anything except its own Presence. An explicit instruction to Damage or Destroy Dahan does nothing to those Dahan; skip that instruction and resolve the rest of the Power normally. For each Power use, evaluate what it would destroy if resolved normally: generate **0 Fear per Explorer, 2 per Town, 5 per City**, and Push the would-be-destroyed Explorers/Towns. No real Damage is marked, so different Powers or a Repeat cannot combine their hypothetical Damage; multiple instructions **within one Power** can. Existing real Damage from others helps its hypothetical destruction and remains unchanged afterward. Within a single Power use, a given Invader can be pretend-destroyed only once. Repeats can “destroy” the same piece again for Fear. It does not get bonuses conditional on **actual** destruction (e.g., Mists of Oblivion or Vengeance of the Dead) from these pretend destructions. [Core: .7w4g7yx, .7w4g7yu, .7w4g8pj, .9v5kfh3, .9v5katc, .bu6oc6g]
- **Bringer's exceptions:** Fear Cards and Dahan counterattacks after its Defend deal real Damage, because they are not its Power's Damage. Bringer can Remove/Replace, add real Blight (destroying Presence normally), modify Invader actions or cause actual Ravage. Reducing Health or replacing a damaged piece with a lower-Health one can cause real destruction by core Health rules. If Bringer Pushes a “destroyed” Town into Ocean, Ocean's separate Drowning destroys it: **3 total Fear** (2 from Bringer, 1 from Ocean). **Spirits May Yet Dream** can flip any Fear Card, earned or anywhere in the deck. Its Element-granting level gives the target Spirit one Element of a type it already has at least one of; it cannot grant a currently absent Element type. [Core: .9v5ka92, .7w4g9jv, .9v5kf34, can-bringer-destroy-things-indirectly, .7w4g8pf, .7w4g8rd]
- **Call on Midnight's Dream:** “Forget this Power” refers to that card, not the newly gained card. Forgetting it to satisfy the gained Major's ordinary Forget requirement also satisfies its conditional; no second Forget is required. The forgotten card leaves play and cannot later be repeated via the normal once-this-turn permission. [Core: .9v5kc3z, .7w4gani, .9v5ka8w]

requested_parts: How is a Spirit’s starting hand obtained, where is its setup Presence placed, what if multiple legal setup choices or two placement instructions name the same land, and is its later play confined to that board
answers.answer: Applied to the stated facts: follow the complete operative rule quoted in the attached evidence.

evidence.text:
1. **Island:** Randomly choose one Island Board per Spirit and join the balanced sides into the island. For one Spirit use one board. For two, any fitting arrangement is legal; the rulebook illustrates bottom-to-bottom with Oceans facing opposite outer corners. For three use the triangular layout, and for four the two-row parallelogram layout illustrated in CORE pp.6–7. [FAQ .7w4g8pg] Populate every land with its printed Invader, Dahan and Blight setup icons. Setup Blight comes from the box, never the Blight pool, and does not cascade or destroy Presence.
2. **Invader deck:** Shuffle each stage separately. Remove one card of each stage unseen. Stack **3 Stage I cards on top, 4 Stage II below them, 5 Stage III at the bottom**. Put this 12-card deck in Explore.
3. **Fear:** Put **4 Fear markers per Spirit** in the Fear Pool. Shuffle the 15 Fear Cards and use 9 unseen: three cards, Terror II divider, three cards, Terror III divider, three cards, from top to bottom. Start at Terror I. Leave space for Earned Fear Cards and Fear discard.
4. **Blight:** Randomly select a Blight Card, Healthy Island side up; do not inspect its reverse. Put **2 Blight per Spirit plus exactly 1 additional Blight total** on it. This is the official initial-pool correction. The additional 1 is applied only at setup, never again on a card flip. Remaining box Blight is separate from this pool.
5. **Supply:** Shuffle Minor and Major decks separately, each with its own discard. Make Invaders, Dahan and Energy available to everyone.
6. **Spirits:** Each player takes one color's 13 Presence and reminder markers (any accidental extra disk is a spare, not additional Presence for play), a different Spirit panel, and that Spirit's four Unique cards as their starting hand. Each starts on a different Island Board and follows the back-of-panel setup exactly. Where several choices equally satisfy setup, choose freely; separate Presence-placement instructions may use the same land. Put remaining disks on the dashed spaces of both Presence tracks; the leftmost solid starting spaces remain uncovered. Starting boards do not restrict where a Spirit can act after setup.
7. **Initial Explore:** Reveal the top Invader card and Explore normally. Then put it face-up in **Build**. This Explore is the last part of setup; Ravage starts empty. The first actual turn begins with the Spirit Phase.

6. **Spirits:** Each player takes one color's 13 Presence and reminder markers (any accidental extra disk is a spare, not additional Presence for play), a different Spirit panel, and that Spirit's four Unique cards as their starting hand. Each starts on a different Island Board and follows the back-of-panel setup exactly. Where several choices equally satisfy setup, choose freely; separate Presence-placement instructions may use the same land. Put remaining disks on the dashed spaces of both Presence tracks; the leftmost solid starting spaces remain uncovered. Starting boards do not restrict where a Spirit can act after setup.

requested_parts: A Growth option includes an impossible instruction and an explicit cost. Can it be selected, can possible instructions be skipped, and may one Spirit wait for another’s Growth result before choosing
answers.answer: Applied to the stated facts: follow the complete operative rule quoted in the attached evidence.

evidence.text: **Growth:** Choose one boxed Growth option unless your panel specifies otherwise. Perform all its instructions if possible, in any order you choose. If an instruction is impossible, do as much as possible and skip that part; an explicit cost for an option must be paid in full to choose it. Common effects:

Retain changes to the Power, including extra Range or changed speed. An ordinary Repeat uses the Power's **most recently assigned speed**: a Slow Power repeats in Slow even if its permission came from a Fast Power; a formerly Fast Power explicitly made Slow before repeating now repeats in Slow. An instruction to Repeat immediately instead follows that explicit timing, directly after the originating use. [FAQ repeating-powers-with-changed-speeds] You may postpone choosing which eligible card to repeat until you actually repeat it, and make different choices/targets then. For **Powerstorm** and **Gift of Strength**, the Spirit receives a once-this-turn option rather than a grant-time selection of cards: a card played later that turn may be selected while it remains in play, subject to the permission’s restrictions and cost. [FAQ timing-of-choosing-powers-for-once-this-turn-repeats] Gift of Strength imposes its printed card-cost eligibility ceiling but requires no additional Energy payment for the Repeat, so an eligible card may be repeated with no Energy left. If the permission requires paying a cost, pay it as instructed. **Powerstorm** requires paying the repeated Power Card's Energy cost again when exercising each Repeat, including its threshold's further permissions; the original play payment does not cover it.

requested_parts: What cards does ordinary Reclaim return, and when and how often can a newly uncovered Reclaim One space be used
answers.answer: Applied to the stated facts: follow the complete operative rule quoted in the attached evidence.

evidence.text:
- **Add Presence:** Choose a legal land within the shown maximum Range of your existing Presence. Take the leftmost remaining disk from either Presence track and add it there. With multiple placements, resolve them sequentially: a newly placed disk may be the origin for the next. You may instead **reposition any of your island Presence**, even with track disks remaining: first measure range and select the destination using existing Presence, including the disk about to be repositioned, then take a disk from anywhere on the island. This is still an Add Presence instruction, not a Move instruction. Destroyed Presence cannot be used unless explicitly permitted.
- **Move Presence:** A curved movement arrow moves the specified Presence from its present location up to the shown distance; this differs from Add/reposition. Push/Gather Presence uses normal adjacency rules. Instructions are mandatory where possible; a move up to a Range can be zero.
- **Gain Energy:** Gain the displayed amount in addition to normal income.
- **Gain a Power Card:** Use the Actions procedure below.
- **Reclaim:** Return all cards in your personal discard to hand, not cards currently in play or forgotten cards.

- **Lightning's Swift Strike:** During Fast, **Swiftness of Lightning** can make one Power Fast per current Air Element; Innates count as Powers too. Recheck current Elements each time; previous uses count against the current allowance. It grants one use at Fast, not an extra use in Slow. **Harbingers of the Lightning** generates its Fear in the target land. [Core: .9v5kehe, when-does-swiftness-of-lightning-happen, if-a-special-rule-cares-about-elements-when-does-it-check-your-element-total, .7w4gefg]
- **River Surges in Sunlight:** **River's Domain** makes its Wetland Presence a Sacred Site without increasing its disk count. When moving/affecting “a Sacred Site,” River may choose 1 or 2 actual Presence there as applicable. [Core: .9v5kfd7, .7w4gebd]
- **Shadows Flicker Like Flame:** Pay **Shadows of the Dahan**'s 1 Energy when using the Power, to ignore numeric Range to a land with Dahan. Source restrictions (such as needing a Sacred Site) and other target requirements remain. The payment's modification carries to a Repeat without paying that surcharge again; an explicit Repeat location still overrides normal targeting. For **Darkness Swallows the Unwary**, choosing lower Elements cannot select the second level without the first when both require the same Elements; if destroying Explorers under that level, first Gather an Explorer if able. [Core: .7w4g8pt, .7w4g8nq, .7w4g8r6, .bu6od0c]
- **A Spread of Rampant Green:** **Choke the Land with Green** is optional (some printings omit “may”). Each use skips just that Ravage or Build action and costs one of Green's Presence in its Sacred Site there. A later Build needs a fresh decision and another disk: starting with three, Green may skip the Ravage, retain a two-disk Sacred Site, then skip the Build and end with one disk. **Steady Regeneration**'s Healthy/Blighted test refers to the Blight Card, not Blight in the destination land. When adding Presence via Growth, Green may use destroyed disks instead of track disks even while disks remain on tracks: this is free while Healthy, or costs 1 Energy per destroyed disk while Blighted. This permission applies only to Growth; an ordinary Power needs its own explicit destroyed-Presence permission. Green's separate **Always** Range-2 Jungle/Wetland placement is additional to its one chosen Growth group, including when it chooses Reclaim/gain a Power. It still chooses only one of the optional groups. Growth instructions from multiple options can be ordered together, so a gained Power may inform the mandatory placement. Its explicit regeneration can use destroyed Presence; ordinary placement cannot. [Core: .9v5kc2v, .7w4g8r1, .bu6oegz, .7w4g8nv]
- **Thunderspeaker:** Presence may accompany each moved Dahan, including generic Move as well as Gather/Push; two Dahan can carry two Presence. **Sworn to Victory** triggers after an entire single-land Ravage for each Dahan destroyed there: destroy one of Thunderspeaker's Presence within Range 1 per Dahan, even if no Blight was added. Finish the Ravage, cascades and counterattack before this triggered loss. [Core: .bu6oc6l, .bu6oc73, .bu6ofsi]
- **Ocean's Hungry Grasp:** On a board with any of Ocean's Presence, the Ocean is a Coastal Wetland for **Powers and Blight**, not for normal Growth, Invader actions or Fear Cards. Powers and Special Rules can measure Range through it as a land. [Core: range-through-ocean] Powers can target it and move Invaders/Dahan into it; Blight can cascade into it. Other Spirits' Presence may end up there via a legal Power, including Thunderspeaker accompanying moved Dahan. You can measure Growth placement Range **from existing Ocean Presence**, although normal Growth cannot add to the Ocean just by treating it as a Coastal Wetland. The Growth group explicitly adding two Presence in **any Ocean** can place them in any board's Ocean, even a board where Ocean has no Presence, without a numeric Range requirement. - **Drowning:** Ocean's rule Drowns Invaders/Dahan **after** they move into the Ocean on a board with Ocean's Presence; Ocean need not have a disk in the Ocean itself. Drown destroys: Town/City Fear happens immediately, and drowned Invaders go on Ocean's panel. At any time, trade stored Invaders: **X printed Health worth of drowned Invaders for 1 Energy**, X = number of Spirits; ignore Health modifiers and make change. They need not be exchanged when Drowned; Ocean may exchange them between actions during a later Spirit Phase, including before paying for cards. Dahan drowning gives no Energy. Ordinary destruction, including thematically watery Powers, is not Drowning unless specified. If Ocean loses all Presence on that board mid-action, Ocean In Play lasts through the action tree; afterward non-human pieces left there remain physically but out of play until it returns. Humans cannot stay there between action trees: if Drowning fails, Push survivors to non-Ocean lands within that action. This is an actual Push and can trigger applicable movement effects, unlike later cleanup. Failed Drowning yields no Energy. Remaining illegal humans are cleaned up to the nearest legal land afterward. Cleanup is not an action, move, removal or destruction and triggers nothing, and occurs before the outcome check. If no legal land exists return humans to supply as cleanup. [Core: .7w4g8qy, .9v5kbka, .7w4g8pb, .9v5ka9g, .7w4g8r4, .9v5kfqb, .9v5kfqs, .7w4gdtl]
- **Bringer of Dreams and Nightmares:** Its Powers' explicit Damage/Destroy cannot actually harm Invaders/Dahan or destroy anything except its own Presence. An explicit instruction to Damage or Destroy Dahan does nothing to those Dahan; skip that instruction and resolve the rest of the Power normally. For each Power use, evaluate what it would destroy if resolved normally: generate **0 Fear per Explorer, 2 per Town, 5 per City**, and Push the would-be-destroyed Explorers/Towns. No real Damage is marked, so different Powers or a Repeat cannot combine their hypothetical Damage; multiple instructions **within one Power** can. Existing real Damage from others helps its hypothetical destruction and remains unchanged afterward. Within a single Power use, a given Invader can be pretend-destroyed only once. Repeats can “destroy” the same piece again for Fear. It does not get bonuses conditional on **actual** destruction (e.g., Mists of Oblivion or Vengeance of the Dead) from these pretend destructions. [Core: .7w4g7yx, .7w4g7yu, .7w4g8pj, .9v5kfh3, .9v5katc, .bu6oc6g]
- **Bringer's exceptions:** Fear Cards and Dahan counterattacks after its Defend deal real Damage, because they are not its Power's Damage. Bringer can Remove/Replace, add real Blight (destroying Presence normally), modify Invader actions or cause actual Ravage. Reducing Health or replacing a damaged piece with a lower-Health one can cause real destruction by core Health rules. If Bringer Pushes a “destroyed” Town into Ocean, Ocean's separate Drowning destroys it: **3 total Fear** (2 from Bringer, 1 from Ocean). **Spirits May Yet Dream** can flip any Fear Card, earned or anywhere in the deck. Its Element-granting level gives the target Spirit one Element of a type it already has at least one of; it cannot grant a currently absent Element type. [Core: .9v5ka92, .7w4g9jv, .9v5kf34, can-bringer-destroy-things-indirectly, .7w4g8pf, .7w4g8rd]
- **Call on Midnight's Dream:** “Forget this Power” refers to that card, not the newly gained card. Forgetting it to satisfy the gained Major's ordinary Forget requirement also satisfies its conditional; no second Forget is required. The forgotten card leaves play and cannot later be repeated via the normal once-this-turn permission. [Core: .9v5kc3z, .7w4gani, .9v5ka8w]

requested_parts: Must a land at Range 0 contain your Presence? Can a numeric Range boost waive a Sacred Site origin, a target-terrain restriction or the text “one of your lands”

evidence.text:
- **Initial Blight:** Exactly one extra Blight total at setup, with or without a card; never repeat this on flips. This and outcome timing above are substantive corrections to older rulebook wording. [Setup: one-more-blight-errata]

They do not extend another Spirit's Powers merely because those Powers target the boosted Spirit. A bonus restricted to Powers does not extend Growth; Power Cards also resolve after normal Growth has finished. Apply the **Power user's** Range bonuses, even if another Spirit supplies the measurement origin. **Blazing Renewal** explicitly uses the Power user's Presence as its origin. - **Fear cards:** **Dahan Raid/Dahan Enheartened** deal the listed total Damage, not that Damage to each Invader. requested_parts: A card adds a Town in Slow and says Invaders skip Build this turn. What remains next turn? At Time Passes where do played cards go, what happens to damaged survivors and reminder markers, and do track Elements vanish
answers.answer: Applied to the stated facts: follow the complete operative rule quoted in the attached evidence.

evidence.text:
- **Lightning's Swift Strike:** During Fast, **Swiftness of Lightning** can make one Power Fast per current Air Element; Innates count as Powers too. Recheck current Elements each time; previous uses count against the current allowance. It grants one use at Fast, not an extra use in Slow. **Harbingers of the Lightning** generates its Fear in the target land. [Core: .9v5kehe, when-does-swiftness-of-lightning-happen, if-a-special-rule-cares-about-elements-when-does-it-check-your-element-total, .7w4gefg]
- **River Surges in Sunlight:** **River's Domain** makes its Wetland Presence a Sacred Site without increasing its disk count. When moving/affecting “a Sacred Site,” River may choose 1 or 2 actual Presence there as applicable. [Core: .9v5kfd7, .7w4gebd]
- **Shadows Flicker Like Flame:** Pay **Shadows of the Dahan**'s 1 Energy when using the Power, to ignore numeric Range to a land with Dahan. Source restrictions (such as needing a Sacred Site) and other target requirements remain. The payment's modification carries to a Repeat without paying that surcharge again; an explicit Repeat location still overrides normal targeting. For **Darkness Swallows the Unwary**, choosing lower Elements cannot select the second level without the first when both require the same Elements; if destroying Explorers under that level, first Gather an Explorer if able. [Core: .7w4g8pt, .7w4g8nq, .7w4g8r6, .bu6od0c]
- **A Spread of Rampant Green:** **Choke the Land with Green** is optional (some printings omit “may”). Each use skips just that Ravage or Build action and costs one of Green's Presence in its Sacred Site there. A later Build needs a fresh decision and another disk: starting with three, Green may skip the Ravage, retain a two-disk Sacred Site, then skip the Build and end with one disk. **Steady Regeneration**'s Healthy/Blighted test refers to the Blight Card, not Blight in the destination land. When adding Presence via Growth, Green may use destroyed disks instead of track disks even while disks remain on tracks: this is free while Healthy, or costs 1 Energy per destroyed disk while Blighted. This permission applies only to Growth; an ordinary Power needs its own explicit destroyed-Presence permission. Green's separate **Always** Range-2 Jungle/Wetland placement is additional to its one chosen Growth group, including when it chooses Reclaim/gain a Power. It still chooses only one of the optional groups. Growth instructions from multiple options can be ordered together, so a gained Power may inform the mandatory placement. Its explicit regeneration can use destroyed Presence; ordinary placement cannot. [Core: .9v5kc2v, .7w4g8r1, .bu6oegz, .7w4g8nv]
- **Thunderspeaker:** Presence may accompany each moved Dahan, including generic Move as well as Gather/Push; two Dahan can carry two Presence. **Sworn to Victory** triggers after an entire single-land Ravage for each Dahan destroyed there: destroy one of Thunderspeaker's Presence within Range 1 per Dahan, even if no Blight was added. Finish the Ravage, cascades and counterattack before this triggered loss. [Core: .bu6oc6l, .bu6oc73, .bu6ofsi]
- **Ocean's Hungry Grasp:** On a board with any of Ocean's Presence, the Ocean is a Coastal Wetland for **Powers and Blight**, not for normal Growth, Invader actions or Fear Cards. Powers and Special Rules can measure Range through it as a land. [Core: range-through-ocean] Powers can target it and move Invaders/Dahan into it; Blight can cascade into it. Other Spirits' Presence may end up there via a legal Power, including Thunderspeaker accompanying moved Dahan. You can measure Growth placement Range **from existing Ocean Presence**, although normal Growth cannot add to the Ocean just by treating it as a Coastal Wetland. The Growth group explicitly adding two Presence in **any Ocean** can place them in any board's Ocean, even a board where Ocean has no Presence, without a numeric Range requirement. Its other group's Range-1 **Coastal land** placement does not permit placing in the Ocean. Other placement must respect Ocean's land-type restriction unless expressly ignored (e.g., **Indomitable Claim** for Inland Presence). [Core: .bu6odcf, .7w4gef8, .9v5kf36, .9v5ka9o, .9v5kc4i, When-OHG-is-in-play-can-other-pieces-end-up-in-the-Ocean]
- **Drowning:** Ocean's rule Drowns Invaders/Dahan **after** they move into the Ocean on a board with Ocean's Presence; Ocean need not have a disk in the Ocean itself. Drown destroys: Town/City Fear happens immediately, and drowned Invaders go on Ocean's panel. At any time, trade stored Invaders: **X printed Health worth of drowned Invaders for 1 Energy**, X = number of Spirits; ignore Health modifiers and make change. They need not be exchanged when Drowned; Ocean may exchange them between actions during a later Spirit Phase, including before paying for cards. Dahan drowning gives no Energy. Ordinary destruction, including thematically watery Powers, is not Drowning unless specified. If Ocean loses all Presence on that board mid-action, Ocean In Play lasts through the action tree; afterward non-human pieces left there remain physically but out of play until it returns. Humans cannot stay there between action trees: if Drowning fails, Push survivors to non-Ocean lands within that action. This is an actual Push and can trigger applicable movement effects, unlike later cleanup. Failed Drowning yields no Energy. Remaining illegal humans are cleaned up to the nearest legal land afterward. Cleanup is not an action, move, removal or destruction and triggers nothing, and occurs before the outcome check. requested_parts: If a Town is replaced by an Explorer while retaining 1 Damage, does the replacement itself cause Fear, does the Explorer survive, and why? Can reduced Health destroy a piece without new Damage
answers.answer: Applied to the stated facts: follow the complete operative rule quoted in the attached evidence.

evidence.text: **Destroy** returns pieces to supply regardless of Health when directly instructed. Every destroyed Town generates **1 Fear** and every destroyed City **2 Fear**, in addition to explicit Fear from the effect. Explorers generate none automatically. **Remove** returns the specified pieces without requiring Damage to reach their Health and without destruction Fear. **Replace** removes a piece and adds another, retaining its marked Damage: the replacement itself produces no Fear, but if the retained Damage destroys the new piece, destruction Fear applies normally. For simultaneous replacements, select all pieces before replacing any: the same original City cannot become a Town and then an Explorer within that one simultaneous instruction. Separate completed instructions or actions may replace the resulting piece again (e.g., successive players resolving **Trade Suffers** at Terror III).

- **Lightning's Swift Strike:** During Fast, **Swiftness of Lightning** can make one Power Fast per current Air Element; Innates count as Powers too. Recheck current Elements each time; previous uses count against the current allowance. It grants one use at Fast, not an extra use in Slow. **Harbingers of the Lightning** generates its Fear in the target land. [Core: .9v5kehe, when-does-swiftness-of-lightning-happen, if-a-special-rule-cares-about-elements-when-does-it-check-your-element-total, .7w4gefg]
- **River Surges in Sunlight:** **River's Domain** makes its Wetland Presence a Sacred Site without increasing its disk count. When moving/affecting “a Sacred Site,” River may choose 1 or 2 actual Presence there as applicable. [Core: .9v5kfd7, .7w4gebd]
- **Shadows Flicker Like Flame:** Pay **Shadows of the Dahan**'s 1 Energy when using the Power, to ignore numeric Range to a land with Dahan. Source restrictions (such as needing a Sacred Site) and other target requirements remain. The payment's modification carries to a Repeat without paying that surcharge again; an explicit Repeat location still overrides normal targeting. For **Darkness Swallows the Unwary**, choosing lower Elements cannot select the second level without the first when both require the same Elements; if destroying Explorers under that level, first Gather an Explorer if able. [Core: .7w4g8pt, .7w4g8nq, .7w4g8r6, .bu6od0c]
- **A Spread of Rampant Green:** **Choke the Land with Green** is optional (some printings omit “may”). Each use skips just that Ravage or Build action and costs one of Green's Presence in its Sacred Site there. A later Build needs a fresh decision and another disk: starting with three, Green may skip the Ravage, retain a two-disk Sacred Site, then skip the Build and end with one disk. **Steady Regeneration**'s Healthy/Blighted test refers to the Blight Card, not Blight in the destination land. When adding Presence via Growth, Green may use destroyed disks instead of track disks even while disks remain on tracks: this is free while Healthy, or costs 1 Energy per destroyed disk while Blighted. This permission applies only to Growth; an ordinary Power needs its own explicit destroyed-Presence permission. Green's separate **Always** Range-2 Jungle/Wetland placement is additional to its one chosen Growth group, including when it chooses Reclaim/gain a Power. It still chooses only one of the optional groups. Growth instructions from multiple options can be ordered together, so a gained Power may inform the mandatory placement. Its explicit regeneration can use destroyed Presence; ordinary placement cannot. [Core: .9v5kc2v, .7w4g8r1, .bu6oegz, .7w4g8nv]
- **Thunderspeaker:** Presence may accompany each moved Dahan, including generic Move as well as Gather/Push; two Dahan can carry two Presence. **Sworn to Victory** triggers after an entire single-land Ravage for each Dahan destroyed there: destroy one of Thunderspeaker's Presence within Range 1 per Dahan, even if no Blight was added. Finish the Ravage, cascades and counterattack before this triggered loss. [Core: .bu6oc6l, .bu6oc73, .bu6ofsi]
- **Ocean's Hungry Grasp:** On a board with any of Ocean's Presence, the Ocean is a Coastal Wetland for **Powers and Blight**, not for normal Growth, Invader actions or Fear Cards. Powers and Special Rules can measure Range through it as a land. [Core: range-through-ocean] Powers can target it and move Invaders/Dahan into it; Blight can cascade into it. Other Spirits' Presence may end up there via a legal Power, including Thunderspeaker accompanying moved Dahan. You can measure Growth placement Range **from existing Ocean Presence**, although normal Growth cannot add to the Ocean just by treating it as a Coastal Wetland. The Growth group explicitly adding two Presence in **any Ocean** can place them in any board's Ocean, even a board where Ocean has no Presence, without a numeric Range requirement. Its other group's Range-1 **Coastal land** placement does not permit placing in the Ocean. Other placement must respect Ocean's land-type restriction unless expressly ignored (e.g., **Indomitable Claim** for Inland Presence). [Core: .bu6odcf, .7w4gef8, .9v5kf36, .9v5ka9o, .9v5kc4i, When-OHG-is-in-play-can-other-pieces-end-up-in-the-Ocean]
- **Drowning:** Ocean's rule Drowns Invaders/Dahan **after** they move into the Ocean on a board with Ocean's Presence; Ocean need not have a disk in the Ocean itself. Drown destroys: Town/City Fear happens immediately, and drowned Invaders go on Ocean's panel. At any time, trade stored Invaders: **X printed Health worth of drowned Invaders for 1 Energy**, X = number of Spirits; ignore Health modifiers and make change. They need not be exchanged when Drowned; Ocean may exchange them between actions during a later Spirit Phase, including before paying for cards. Dahan drowning gives no Energy. Ordinary destruction, including thematically watery Powers, is not Drowning unless specified. This is an actual Push and can trigger applicable movement effects, unlike later cleanup. Failed Drowning yields no Energy. - **Bringer of Dreams and Nightmares:** Its Powers' explicit Damage/Destroy cannot actually harm Invaders/Dahan or destroy anything except its own Presence. An explicit instruction to Damage or Destroy Dahan does nothing to those Dahan; skip that instruction and resolve the rest of the Power normally. If Bringer Pushes a “destroyed” Town into Ocean, Ocean's separate Drowning destroys it: **3 total Fear** (2 from Bringer, 1 from Ocean). **Spirits May Yet Dream** can flip any Fear Card, earned or anywhere in the deck. Its Element-granting level gives the target Spirit one Element of a type it already has at least one of; it cannot grant a currently absent Element type. [Core: .9v5ka92, .7w4g9jv, .9v5kf34, can-bringer-destroy-things-indirectly, .7w4g8pf, .7w4g8rd]
- **Call on Midnight's Dream:** “Forget this Power” refers to that card, not the newly gained card. Forgetting it to satisfy the gained Major's ordinary Forget requirement also satisfies its conditional; no second Forget is required. The forgotten card leaves play and cannot later be repeated via the normal once-this-turn permission. [Core: .9v5kc3z, .7w4gani, .9v5ka8w]

- **Initial Blight:** Exactly one extra Blight total at setup, with or without a card; never repeat this on flips. This and outcome timing above are substantive corrections to older rulebook wording. [Setup: one-more-blight-errata]
- **Range boosts:** Numeric Range boosts do not waive source/target restrictions or the requirement “one of your lands.” A Power still requiring your Sacred Site must have such an origin. General Power Range boosts affect Range values with a **printed Range arrow** in Powers **used by the Spirit receiving the bonus**, including effect-text arrows, subject to all restrictions. They do **not** increase the amount of another Range bonus: another boost cannot turn **Reaching Grasp**'s printed +2 into a larger bonus. They do not extend another Spirit's Powers merely because those Powers target the boosted Spirit. A bonus restricted to Powers does not extend Growth; Power Cards also resolve after normal Growth has finished. A special rule granting extra Range specifically for targeting lands with certain contents changes only the targeting Range box: **Shadows of the Dahan** does not extend effect-text Range arrows. [Core: special-rule-range-bonuses-to-targeting; official FAQ: [Range boosts](https://querki.net/raw/darker/spirit-island-faq/What-do-range-boosts-affect)] [Core: .3y28aqg, .7w4g8nq]

Apply the **Power user's** Range bonuses, even if another Spirit supplies the measurement origin. **Blazing Renewal** explicitly uses the Power user's Presence as its origin. Bonuses belonging only to the instructed Spirit do not extend someone else's Power. [Official FAQ: [internal Range](https://querki.net/raw/darker/spirit-island-faq/range-in-text-of-powers-that-target-spirits)]
- **Changing contents:** A single-land Power normally counts contents when used and fixes the effect then. [Core: .3y28aex, .7w4g8q9, Repeating-internal-range-boosts]

[Core: scapegoats-action] [Core: .7w4g8rq, .7w4g8ra, .bu6ocpc, .7w4g8qr]

Its printed “adds 2” is mandatory to the extent possible, using the Power user's Presence for its internal Range; it cannot deal threshold Damage with no destroyed Presence restored: “that land” refers to where it adds Presence. **The Trees and Stones Speak of War** deals 1 Damage per Dahan and grants Defend 2 per Dahan in its target land. Its threshold moves Defend 2 with each Dahan it Pushes, leaving the remaining Defend in the target. Only this Power's Defend 2 per pushed Dahan travels; separate Defend from another effect, such as Words of Warning, stays in its original land. A later Power moving those Dahan does not carry that Defend. [Core: .9v5kfqd, .9v5kfr0, .bu6oc8n, .bu6ocxq]
- **Protection:** **Infinite Vitality** replaces an attempted Blight addition by leaving that Blight in the active Blight Card/board pool. That prevented addition neither destroys Presence nor cascades. Its threshold protects Dahan from Damage/Destroy, not Remove/Replace. Its Blight protection does not make the land an illegal cascade destination. [Core: .bu6ocxx, .7w4g8q2]
- **Entwined Power:** Shared Presence applies only to targeting (Range/source/target boxes), not to text effects or counting “your lands.” One disk each can count as a Sacred Site for their Power targeting, but is not a real shared site for Fear Cards or other effects. River's special Wetland-site rule remains River's own. For its base card gains, the **target Spirit** first makes the normal draw-four/keep-one gain; the **using Spirit** then gains one of those same three unkept cards, without drawing another four. In solo, both gains come from that single four-card draw. The threshold also lets the using and target Spirits each independently gift the other one Power Card **from hand**, optionally; cards in play or personal discard cannot be gifted by it. The threshold gives 6 Energy in solo; each Major gained still needs a separate Forget. If a transferred Unique references a special effect defined by a Spirit's rule, such as Drown, that definition still applies; skip instructions requiring a personal track you do not have. [Core: .3y28auq, .3y28aeu, .7w4g9jw, .7w4gee7, .7w4g8p9]
- **Spirit-targeting Powers:** When the target Spirit selects “one of their lands,” it chooses the land and does as much there as possible, even if another of its lands would permit more instructions. Thus **Mantle of Dread** may Push an Explorer from a land without a Town, and **Tidal Boon** may Push Dahan from a land without a Town. Tidal Boon's “if Dahan are pushed” clause applies only to that Power's own Push. When Ocean uses Tidal Boon, Ocean may move Dahan pushed to its Ocean by that use to **any Coastal land**, including a nonadjacent one, instead of Drowning them. Ocean chooses; this alternative is optional. [Original core card text] Spirit-targeting Fear without a specified land has no particular land for **Dread Apparitions**. [Core: .9v5kfhb, .7w4gdab, .bu6oebp, where-do-spirit-targeting-powers-add-their-fear]

Green's separate **Always** Range-2 Jungle/Wetland placement is additional to its one chosen Growth group, including when it chooses Reclaim/gain a Power. - **Ocean's Hungry Grasp:** On a board with any of Ocean's Presence, the Ocean is a Coastal Wetland for **Powers and Blight**, not for normal Growth, Invader actions or Fear Cards. Other Spirits' Presence may end up there via a legal Power, including Thunderspeaker accompanying moved Dahan. - **Drowning:** Ocean's rule Drowns Invaders/Dahan **after** they move into the Ocean on a board with Ocean's Presence; Ocean need not have a disk in the Ocean itself. This is an actual Push and can trigger applicable movement effects, unlike later cleanup. Failed Drowning yields no Energy. - **Bringer of Dreams and Nightmares:** Its Powers' explicit Damage/Destroy cannot actually harm Invaders/Dahan or destroy anything except its own Presence. - **Bringer's exceptions:** Fear Cards and Dahan counterattacks after its Defend deal real Damage, because they are not its Power's Damage. Bringer can Remove/Replace, add real Blight (destroying Presence normally), modify Invader actions or cause actual Ravage. Reducing Health or replacing a damaged piece with a lower-Health one can cause real destruction by core Health rules. - **Call on Midnight's Dream:** “Forget this Power” refers to that card, not the newly gained card. Forgetting it to satisfy the gained Major's ordinary Forget requirement also satisfies its conditional; no second Forget is required. The forgotten card leaves play and cannot later be repeated via the normal once-this-turn permission. [Core: .9v5kc3z, .7w4gani, .9v5ka8w]

- **Range boosts:** Numeric Range boosts do not waive source/target restrictions or the requirement “one of your lands.” A Power still requiring your Sacred Site must have such an origin. They do **not** increase the amount of another Range bonus: another boost cannot turn **Reaching Grasp**'s printed +2 into a larger bonus. They do not extend another Spirit's Powers merely because those Powers target the boosted Spirit. - **Internal Range origins:** A Range arrow inside a land-targeting Power's effects is measured from the **target land**, unless stated otherwise. - **Changing contents:** A single-land Power normally counts contents when used and fixes the effect then. - **Innates with only self-modification:** A level merely changing a Power's own Speed/Range is insufficient to count as using/targeting it; it must have some instruction with potential to change the game state, even if no actual change occurs. - **Repeat limits:** **Powerstorm** and **Gift of Strength** repeat Power **Cards**, not Innates. Powerstorm's threshold repeats up to three **different** cards. A Range/Speed change granted by a threshold carries to a Repeat even if that threshold is no longer met; it does not stack the same Range bonus again. [Core: .3y28aex, .7w4g8q9, Repeating-internal-range-boosts]
- **Triggered effects:** “After” effects resolve after the whole originating action, not after each instruction within a Power. A triggered effect cannot trigger itself, even indirectly. Separately repeated instances can trigger one another, but neither can recur within its own chain. **Vengeance of the Dead** uses this timing; its corrected base text grants 3 Fear and, after an effect destroys Towns/Cities/Dahan in target land, deals 1 Damage per such piece destroyed. Its threshold may send that Damage into adjacent lands, while the original target remains the land whose qualifying destruction triggers it. [Core: what-items-are-triggered-actions, .bu6oc8x, .7w4gdth, .7w4gdtj]
- **Fear cards:** **Dahan Raid/Dahan Enheartened** deal the listed total Damage, not that Damage to each Invader. [Core: scapegoats-action] [Core: .7w4g8rq, .7w4g8ra, .bu6ocpc, .7w4g8qr]
- **Reading choices and Damage:** In **Crops Wither and Fade**, always gain 2 Fear before the City-or-Town replacement choice; “or” only divides adjacent clauses. **Veil the Night's Hunt** must put each point on a different Invader, wasting excess when there are fewer Invaders than Dahan. [Core: .9v5kavn, .7w4g8qc, .7w4g8p0, is-boosted-damage-from-the-same-source]
- **Core Power specifics:** **Song of Sanctity** is Slow, despite missing cost-circle ink in some printings. [Core: .7w4g9dg, .9v5kc31, .7w4ganc, .7w4g8q3, .7w4g8pc]
- **Dread Apparitions Fear sources:** While its effect is active, Power-generated Fear in its target land adds **Defend 1 per Fear**. - **Location-dependent effects:** **Wrap in Wings of Sunlight** resolves its threshold’s **First, Gather up to 3 Dahan** before its base Move; those gathered Dahan may then move and allow the destination’s Defend. It grants no Defend if zero Dahan move: there is no moved-to land. Its threshold moves Defend 2 with each Dahan it Pushes, leaving the remaining Defend in the target. A later Power moving those Dahan does not carry that Defend. [Core: .9v5kfqd, .9v5kfr0, .bu6oc8n, .bu6ocxq]
- **Protection:** **Infinite Vitality** replaces an attempted Blight addition by leaving that Blight in the active Blight Card/board pool. - **Entwined Power:** Shared Presence applies only to targeting (Range/source/target boxes), not to text effects or counting “your lands.” One disk each can count as a Sacred Site for their Power targeting, but is not a real shared site for Fear Cards or other effects. River's special Wetland-site rule remains River's own. For its base card gains, the **target Spirit** first makes the normal draw-four/keep-one gain; the **using Spirit** then gains one of those same three unkept cards, without drawing another four. [Core: .3y28auq, .3y28aeu, .7w4g9jw, .7w4gee7, .7w4g8p9]
- **Spirit-targeting Powers:** When the target Spirit selects “one of their lands,” it chooses the land and does as much there as possible, even if another of its lands would permit more instructions. Thus **Mantle of Dread** may Push an Explorer from a land without a Town, and **Tidal Boon** may Push Dahan from a land without a Town. Tidal Boon's “if Dahan are pushed” clause applies only to that Power's own Push. When Ocean uses Tidal Boon, Ocean may move Dahan pushed to its Ocean by that use to **any Coastal land**, including a nonadjacent one, instead of Drowning them. Ocean chooses; this alternative is optional. [Original core card text] Spirit-targeting Fear without a specified land has no particular land for **Dread Apparitions**. [Core: .9v5kfhb, .7w4gdab, .bu6oebp, where-do-spirit-targeting-powers-add-their-fear]

requested_parts: What is the difference between a Growth Move Presence arrow and Add Presence using an island disk? Can the latter pick up a disk outside the shown Range of the destination
answers.answer: Applied to the stated facts: follow the complete operative rule quoted in the attached evidence.

evidence.text:
- **Add Presence:** Choose a legal land within the shown maximum Range of your existing Presence. Take the leftmost remaining disk from either Presence track and add it there. With multiple placements, resolve them sequentially: a newly placed disk may be the origin for the next. You may instead **reposition any of your island Presence**, even with track disks remaining: first measure range and select the destination using existing Presence, including the disk about to be repositioned, then take a disk from anywhere on the island. This is still an Add Presence instruction, not a Move instruction. Destroyed Presence cannot be used unless explicitly permitted.
- **Move Presence:** A curved movement arrow moves the specified Presence from its present location up to the shown distance; this differs from Add/reposition. Push/Gather Presence uses normal adjacency rules. Instructions are mandatory where possible; a move up to a Range can be zero.
- **Gain Energy:** Gain the displayed amount in addition to normal income.
- **Gain a Power Card:** Use the Actions procedure below.
- **Reclaim:** Return all cards in your personal discard to hand, not cards currently in play or forgotten cards.

- **Initial Blight:** Exactly one extra Blight total at setup, with or without a card; never repeat this on flips. This and outcome timing above are substantive corrections to older rulebook wording. [Setup: one-more-blight-errata]
- **Range boosts:** Numeric Range boosts do not waive source/target restrictions or the requirement “one of your lands.” A Power still requiring your Sacred Site must have such an origin. They do **not** increase the amount of another Range bonus: another boost cannot turn **Reaching Grasp**'s printed +2 into a larger bonus. They do not extend another Spirit's Powers merely because those Powers target the boosted Spirit. A bonus restricted to Powers does not extend Growth; Power Cards also resolve after normal Growth has finished. A special rule granting extra Range specifically for targeting lands with certain contents changes only the targeting Range box: **Shadows of the Dahan** does not extend effect-text Range arrows. [Core: special-rule-range-bonuses-to-targeting; official FAQ: [Range boosts](https://querki.net/raw/darker/spirit-island-faq/What-do-range-boosts-affect)] [Core: .3y28aqg, .7w4g8nq]
- **Internal Range origins:** A Range arrow inside a land-targeting Power's effects is measured from the **target land**, unless stated otherwise. In a Spirit-targeting Power's effects, measure from the Presence of the Spirit following that instruction (usually the target Spirit), unless the Power says otherwise. Apply the **Power user's** Range bonuses, even if another Spirit supplies the measurement origin. **Blazing Renewal** explicitly uses the Power user's Presence as its origin. Bonuses belonging only to the instructed Spirit do not extend someone else's Power. [Official FAQ: [internal Range](https://querki.net/raw/darker/spirit-island-faq/range-in-text-of-powers-that-target-spirits)]
- **Changing contents:** A single-land Power normally counts contents when used and fixes the effect then. Island-wide effects defined for a class of lands check current contents when relevant (for example, **Dahan on their Guard** counts Dahan when Damage occurs). **Encompassing Ward** follows the target Spirit's current Presence, rather than marking the lands occupied when it was used. - **Innates with only self-modification:** A level merely changing a Power's own Speed/Range is insufficient to count as using/targeting it; it must have some instruction with potential to change the game state, even if no actual change occurs. - **Repeat limits:** **Powerstorm** and **Gift of Strength** repeat Power **Cards**, not Innates. Powerstorm's threshold repeats up to three **different** cards. [Core: .3y28aex, .7w4g8q9, Repeating-internal-range-boosts]
- **Triggered effects:** “After” effects resolve after the whole originating action, not after each instruction within a Power. A triggered effect cannot trigger itself, even indirectly. [Core: .3y28auq, .3y28aeu, .7w4g9jw, .7w4gee7, .7w4g8p9]
- **Spirit-targeting Powers:** When the target Spirit selects “one of their lands,” it chooses the land and does as much there as possible, even if another of its lands would permit more instructions. Tidal Boon's “if Dahan are pushed” clause applies only to that Power's own Push. When Ocean uses Tidal Boon, Ocean may move Dahan pushed to its Ocean by that use to **any Coastal land**, including a nonadjacent one, instead of Drowning them. Ocean chooses; this alternative is optional. [Original core card text] Spirit-targeting Fear without a specified land has no particular land for **Dread Apparitions**. [Core: .9v5kfhb, .7w4gdab, .bu6oebp, where-do-spirit-targeting-powers-add-their-fear]

requested_parts: What makes two lands adjacent, including across boards?

requested_parts: How is a Spirit’s starting hand obtained, where is its setup Presence placed, what if multiple legal setup choices or two placement instructions name the same land, and is its later play confined to that board?
answers.answer: Starting hand is four Unique Powers. Setup Presence follows back-panel instructions; equally valid setup choices are free, and instructions may place in same land. Later play isn't confined to starting board.

evidence.text:
1. **Island:** Randomly choose one Island Board per Spirit and join the balanced sides into the island. For one Spirit use one board. For two, any fitting arrangement is legal; the rulebook illustrates bottom-to-bottom with Oceans facing opposite outer corners. For three use the triangular layout, and for four the two-row parallelogram layout illustrated in CORE pp.6–7. [FAQ .7w4g8pg] Populate every land with its printed Invader, Dahan and Blight setup icons. Setup Blight comes from the box, never the Blight pool, and does not cascade or destroy Presence.
2. **Invader deck:** Shuffle each stage separately. Remove one card of each stage unseen. Stack **3 Stage I cards on top, 4 Stage II below them, 5 Stage III at the bottom**. Put this 12-card deck in Explore.
3. **Fear:** Put **4 Fear markers per Spirit** in the Fear Pool. Shuffle the 15 Fear Cards and use 9 unseen: three cards, Terror II divider, three cards, Terror III divider, three cards, from top to bottom. Start at Terror I. Leave space for Earned Fear Cards and Fear discard.
4. **Blight:** Randomly select a Blight Card, Healthy Island side up; do not inspect its reverse. Put **2 Blight per Spirit plus exactly 1 additional Blight total** on it. This is the official initial-pool correction. The additional 1 is applied only at setup, never again on a card flip. Remaining box Blight is separate from this pool.
5. **Supply:** Shuffle Minor and Major decks separately, each with its own discard. Make Invaders, Dahan and Energy available to everyone.
6. **Spirits:** Each player takes one color's 13 Presence and reminder markers (any accidental extra disk is a spare, not additional Presence for play), a different Spirit panel, and that Spirit's four Unique cards as their starting hand. Each starts on a different Island Board and follows the back-of-panel setup exactly. Where several choices equally satisfy setup, choose freely; separate Presence-placement instructions may use the same land. Put remaining disks on the dashed spaces of both Presence tracks; the leftmost solid starting spaces remain uncovered. Starting boards do not restrict where a Spirit can act after setup.
7. **Initial Explore:** Reveal the top Invader card and Explore normally. Then put it face-up in **Build**. This Explore is the last part of setup; Ravage starts empty. The first actual turn begins with the Spirit Phase.

- The **targeting Range box** gives the maximum land distance from **one of your Presence**. Range 0 requires your Presence in the target land. Origin icons may require your Sacred Site or Presence in a particular terrain.
- Target restrictions may specify terrain, Coastal/Inland, contents, or a Spirit. A slash between piece/terrain icons means either or both types, not an additional allowance for each.
- Unless explicitly different, use **one target land or Spirit, once per turn**. Multiple effects and all innate levels apply to that same target. You cannot pay twice for an ordinary card use or use an innate twice just by having twice its Elements.
- Resolve instructions in printed order, doing as much as possible. Inability to perform one instruction does not prohibit playing or using a Power on an otherwise legal target. Target restrictions are in its target bar, not implied by its text. You may even target a land where the effects accomplish nothing, but must actually attempt the text to count as using/targeting the Power.
- You may forego the whole Power, but cannot arbitrarily omit a possible mandatory instruction after starting. “Up to” allows zero. “Or” chooses between its adjoining clauses, not other separate text on the card. Choose the branch **before resolving either option**; you cannot start one to inspect its results and then switch to the other. [FAQ .9v5kcmx]
- Resolve the base effect and every met threshold in printed order **unless explicit timing text says otherwise**: “First” and “Before” can place a threshold instruction ahead of earlier-printed base instructions. A level saying **Instead** replaces previous effects rather than adding to them. You may treat yourself as having fewer Elements **for the whole Power**, consistently, rather than selecting individual thresholds to omit.
- Check Elements when a threshold is reached: newly gained Elements can enable later levels; losing Elements can prevent later levels, without changing completed effects. Apply a threshold changing Speed, Range or targeting when checking that attribute, before the ordinary effects: for example, Thunderspeaker's met Fast threshold permits using its Innate in Fast. Speed/Range/targeting modifiers are checked in time to use them before targeting, and an “or” choice is made before its branch resolves.
- Non-board-changing effects last for this turn only unless explicitly stated otherwise. Defend and action skips do not remain for future turns.

- **Initial Blight:** Exactly one extra Blight total at setup, with or without a card; never repeat this on flips. This and outcome timing above are substantive corrections to older rulebook wording. [Setup: one-more-blight-errata]
- **Range boosts:** Numeric Range boosts do not waive source/target restrictions or the requirement “one of your lands.” A Power still requiring your Sacred Site must have such an origin. General Power Range boosts affect Range values with a **printed Range arrow** in Powers **used by the Spirit receiving the bonus**, including effect-text arrows, subject to all restrictions. They do **not** increase the amount of another Range bonus: another boost cannot turn **Reaching Grasp**'s printed +2 into a larger bonus. They do not extend another Spirit's Powers merely because those Powers target the boosted Spirit. A bonus restricted to Powers does not extend Growth; Power Cards also resolve after normal Growth has finished. A special rule granting extra Range specifically for targeting lands with certain contents changes only the targeting Range box: **Shadows of the Dahan** does not extend effect-text Range arrows. [Core: special-rule-range-bonuses-to-targeting; official FAQ: [Range boosts](https://querki.net/raw/darker/spirit-island-faq/What-do-range-boosts-affect)] [Core: .3y28aqg, .7w4g8nq]
- **Internal Range origins:** A Range arrow inside a land-targeting Power's effects is measured from the **target land**, unless stated otherwise. Bonuses belonging only to the instructed Spirit do not extend someone else's Power. - **Changing contents:** A single-land Power normally counts contents when used and fixes the effect then. requested_parts: Does one Presence each from two Spirits form a Sacred Site?
Does four Presence from one Spirit count as two sites, and what does “your land” mean?
answers.answer: No, Sacred Site requires at least two of your own Presence in one land; one each from two Spirits isn't. Four of your Presence there is still one site. “Your land” has your Presence.

requested_parts: What cards does ordinary Reclaim return, and when and how often can a newly uncovered Reclaim One space be used?
answers.answer: Ordinary Reclaim returns all cards from personal discard, not in-play/forgotten. Reclaim One space lets take one discarded card once each Spirit Phase at any point, including turn revealed.

evidence.text:
- **Add Presence:** Choose a legal land within the shown maximum Range of your existing Presence. Take the leftmost remaining disk from either Presence track and add it there. With multiple placements, resolve them sequentially: a newly placed disk may be the origin for the next. You may instead **reposition any of your island Presence**, even with track disks remaining: first measure range and select the destination using existing Presence, including the disk about to be repositioned, then take a disk from anywhere on the island. This is still an Add Presence instruction, not a Move instruction. Destroyed Presence cannot be used unless explicitly permitted.
- **Move Presence:** A curved movement arrow moves the specified Presence from its present location up to the shown distance; this differs from Add/reposition. Push/Gather Presence uses normal adjacency rules. Instructions are mandatory where possible; a move up to a Range can be zero.
- **Gain Energy:** Gain the displayed amount in addition to normal income.
- **Gain a Power Card:** Use the Actions procedure below.
- **Reclaim:** Return all cards in your personal discard to hand, not cards currently in play or forgotten cards.

Track Element spaces grant their Elements continuously while uncovered; unlike numbered track benefits these are additional Elements. In contrast, a flexible Element directly granted by an action must be chosen immediately when gained. [FAQ choosing-flexible-elements]

requested_parts: When a track Element is revealed after Growth, when does it become usable?
When may an Any track Element be chosen and changed, and what if an in-play card is Forgotten?
answers.answer: Track elements are continuous while uncovered, so usable as soon revealed in Growth. Any track Element can be chosen anytime each turn and locked until next turn. Flexible Element granted directly must be chosen immediately. Forgetting in-play card immediately removes its Elements and unused activation.

evidence.text: A revealed **Reclaim One** track space permits taking one card from your personal discard to hand once each Spirit Phase, at any point in that phase, including the turn revealed. Track Element spaces grant their Elements continuously while uncovered; unlike numbered track benefits these are additional Elements. Choose an **Any** track Element at any time each turn, but once chosen do not change it until next turn. In contrast, a flexible Element directly granted by an action must be chosen immediately when gained. [FAQ choosing-flexible-elements]

requested_parts: A Power’s earlier instruction uncovers an Element needed for a later threshold. Can that later threshold apply?
What if Elements are lost instead, and can earlier resolved effects be revised?
answers.answer: Yes; newly gained Elements can enable later threshold. Losing Elements can prevent later threshold but completed effects remain unchanged.

requested_parts: Must a land at Range 0 contain your Presence?
Can a numeric Range boost waive a Sacred Site origin, a target-terrain restriction or the text “one of your lands”?
answers.answer: Range 0 requires your Presence in target. Numeric boost does not waive Sacred Site/source, terrain/target restrictions or “one of your lands.”

evidence.text:
- The **targeting Range box** gives the maximum land distance from **one of your Presence**. Range 0 requires your Presence in the target land. Origin icons may require your Sacred Site or Presence in a particular terrain.
- Target restrictions may specify terrain, Coastal/Inland, contents, or a Spirit. A slash between piece/terrain icons means either or both types, not an additional allowance for each.
- Unless explicitly different, use **one target land or Spirit, once per turn**. Multiple effects and all innate levels apply to that same target. You cannot pay twice for an ordinary card use or use an innate twice just by having twice its Elements.
- Resolve instructions in printed order, doing as much as possible. Inability to perform one instruction does not prohibit playing or using a Power on an otherwise legal target. Target restrictions are in its target bar, not implied by its text. You may even target a land where the effects accomplish nothing, but must actually attempt the text to count as using/targeting the Power.
- You may forego the whole Power, but cannot arbitrarily omit a possible mandatory instruction after starting. “Up to” allows zero. “Or” chooses between its adjoining clauses, not other separate text on the card. Choose the branch **before resolving either option**; you cannot start one to inspect its results and then switch to the other. [FAQ .9v5kcmx]
- Resolve the base effect and every met threshold in printed order **unless explicit timing text says otherwise**: “First” and “Before” can place a threshold instruction ahead of earlier-printed base instructions. A level saying **Instead** replaces previous effects rather than adding to them. You may treat yourself as having fewer Elements **for the whole Power**, consistently, rather than selecting individual thresholds to omit.
- Check Elements when a threshold is reached: newly gained Elements can enable later levels; losing Elements can prevent later levels, without changing completed effects. Apply a threshold changing Speed, Range or targeting when checking that attribute, before the ordinary effects: for example, Thunderspeaker's met Fast threshold permits using its Innate in Fast. Speed/Range/targeting modifiers are checked in time to use them before targeting, and an “or” choice is made before its branch resolves.
- Non-board-changing effects last for this turn only unless explicitly stated otherwise. Defend and action skips do not remain for future turns.

- **Initial Blight:** Exactly one extra Blight total at setup, with or without a card; never repeat this on flips. This and outcome timing above are substantive corrections to older rulebook wording. [Setup: one-more-blight-errata]
- **Range boosts:** Numeric Range boosts do not waive source/target restrictions or the requirement “one of your lands.” A Power still requiring your Sacred Site must have such an origin. General Power Range boosts affect Range values with a **printed Range arrow** in Powers **used by the Spirit receiving the bonus**, including effect-text arrows, subject to all restrictions. They do **not** increase the amount of another Range bonus: another boost cannot turn **Reaching Grasp**'s printed +2 into a larger bonus. They do not extend another Spirit's Powers merely because those Powers target the boosted Spirit. A bonus restricted to Powers does not extend Growth; Power Cards also resolve after normal Growth has finished. A special rule granting extra Range specifically for targeting lands with certain contents changes only the targeting Range box: **Shadows of the Dahan** does not extend effect-text Range arrows. - **Internal Range origins:** A Range arrow inside a land-targeting Power's effects is measured from the **target land**, unless stated otherwise. In a Spirit-targeting Power's effects, measure from the Presence of the Spirit following that instruction (usually the target Spirit), unless the Power says otherwise. Apply the **Power user's** Range bonuses, even if another Spirit supplies the measurement origin. **Blazing Renewal** explicitly uses the Power user's Presence as its origin. Bonuses belonging only to the instructed Spirit do not extend someone else's Power. - **Changing contents:** A single-land Power normally counts contents when used and fixes the effect then. Island-wide effects defined for a class of lands check current contents when relevant (for example, **Dahan on their Guard** counts Dahan when Damage occurs). **Encompassing Ward** follows the target Spirit's current Presence, rather than marking the lands occupied when it was used.
